title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex:governing equations and solver.cpp:717–797 implement compressible conservation with BDF terms; forced Re200 adds a momentum source, so its physical case is evaluated separately.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:105–220 reads unstructured zones and explicit one-to-one point connectivity; :264–305 handles triangle/quadrilateral-sized sections but not general MIXED sections; :357–418 builds adjacency. No general mesh test was repeated.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:717–783 assembles face residuals; :786–799 adds physical-time terms. Re200 also includes a prescribed source at :801–810, which changes the required unforced case.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:527–614 contains Roe and Rusanov numerical fluxes with positivity fallback; production report records Roe for the transient. No independent flux-order test was run.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:755–771 applies wall and farfield face treatments; report and surface data provide boundary-state checks. Independent wall accuracy was not rerun.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:389–470 computes weighted gradients and limiter; report.tex:746 discloses first-order fallback for faces touching cells below 1e-6 and use of a steady sponge. Some cases remain shallow plateaus.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:427–470 implements bounded limiting with positivity protection; small-cell first-order fallback is documented and affects production fidelity.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:614–715 computes viscous and thermal fluxes; :1230–1261 projects traction to its tangential component for skin-friction forces. Submitted wall fields and nonzero Cf are available; no grid-convergence check was repeated.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:864–940 forms approximate Jacobian and LU-SGS updates; steady CFL caps and shallow plateaus are disclosed. Full independent linear-solver verification was not performed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1658–1809 has a 2000-step backward-Euler dt ramp then nominal dt=0.01 BDF2 inner solve; final t=306.67 and metadata reports target convergence. Prescribed time-periodic wake forcing through t=300 means the reported periodic response cannot verify the required unforced case.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS graph partition in mesh.cpp:465, local owned/ghost records and neighbor exchanges solver.cpp:237–249; rank continuations agree at np2 and np8. Initialization also gathers wall-geometry points but no full conservative-state allgather was identified during iterations.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
